headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 16, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 shutout loss to the Chicago Cubs, while the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0 behind Chase Burns' strong performance. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, and the Chicago White Sox took down the Detroit Tigers in a thrilling 4-3 contest.

Injuries continue to plague several teams, with Sebastián Rivero (Los Angeles Angels) and Vladimir Guerrero Jr. (Toronto Blue Jays) both landing on the injured list. Abner Uribe (Milwaukee Brewers) was placed on the 15-day injured list with a right forearm flexor strain, while Davis Martin (Chicago White Sox) will miss time with a right middle finger blister.

The Milwaukee Brewers acquired Jonathan Ornelas from the Athletics in a cash trade, while the Baltimore Orioles received Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox as part of a player-to-be-named-later deal. The Kansas City Royals acquired Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Cubs in 3-0 Shutout**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals suffered a 3-0 loss to the Chicago Cubs, with the Cubs' pitching staff shutting out the Cardinals.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Marlins in Close Contest**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds edged out the Miami Marlins 1-0, with Chase Burns pitching a strong 7.0 innings, striking out 8 batters and allowing 0 earned runs. Eugenio Suárez led the Reds' offense with a double and 1 RBI.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Red Sox 8-4**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 8-4 victory over the Boston Red Sox, with Bubba Chandler earning the win after 5.0 innings of work. Rafael Flores Jr. led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, and 2 RBIs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Take Down Tigers 9-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a 9-5 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Miguel Vargas leading the charge at the plate. Vargas hit two home runs, including his 27th of the season, and drove in three runs.

top_news.title: **White Sox Edge Tigers in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago White Sox secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 4-3. Randal Grichuk, Andrew Benintendi, Tristan Peters, and Eduardo Valencia all contributed to the White Sox's offense.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Cubs 8-4**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals secured an 8-4 victory over the Chicago Cubs, led by standout performances from several players. Alec Burleson, Joshua Báez, Blaze Jordan, Pedro Ramírez, and Michael Conforto all made significant impacts at the plate.

top_news.title: **Rivero Lands on 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Los Angeles Angels catcher Sebastián Rivero has been placed on the 60-day injured list due to a left hamate fracture. The injury occurred on August 15, 2026.

top_news.title: **Brewers Bolster Infield with Ornelas Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers have strengthened their lineup with the addition of shortstop Jonathan Ornelas, acquired in a trade with the Athletics for cash.
